description: Concrete request/response fixtures for the PIP-owned cross-model retrieval transport (S-001/TK-001). Proves client identity is checked, no backend credential ever reaches a client, provenance/freshness survive translation (falling back to explicit 'unknown' rather than a fabricated value while OpenBrain S-003/TK-003 is incomplete), and the adapter fails closed on disable/unreachable/unauthorized/invalid states without touching canonical Markdown/Git or OpenBrain ingestion.

cases.summary: Approved client retrieves results where OpenBrain has already supplied a truthful freshness signal.

request.clientToken: <per-client token, opaque to PIP's client registry, never OpenBrain's token>

results.content: Foundry Sockets own the socket contract; instances own the binding.

cases.summary: Current real upstream case: OpenBrain's query-wiki contract does not yet emit provenance/freshness fields (blocked on OpenBrain S-003/TK-003, which itself waits on S-002 and S-004). PIP must propagate an explicit 'unknown' status rather than inventing 'fresh'.

results.content: opaque upstream match content, unchanged from OpenBrain's response

cases.summary: clientId/clientToken is missing, malformed, or not on PIP's approved registry. Fails closed before any upstream call; no OpenBrain credential is ever at risk.

response.message: clientId is not on the approved registry.

cases.summary: Malformed request body (missing query, or a field outside bounds). Rejected by the same validation the transport enforces before touching the client registry or upstream.

response.message: query must be a non-empty string of at most 8000 characters.

cases.summary: Owner has flipped the adapter's local kill switch (e.g. PIP_ADAPTER_ENABLED=false). PIP fails closed immediately, before checking client identity or calling OpenBrain. Canonical Markdown/Git and OpenBrain ingestion are untouched; recovery is re-enabling the flag and re-running doctor/health.

response.message: The PIP retrieval adapter is disabled by the operator. No request reached OpenBrain.

cases.summary: OpenBrain's query-wiki endpoint could not be reached or returned a transport-level failure. PIP never fabricates a result set to paper over the outage; it reports the failure and lets the caller retry or fall back.

response.message: OpenBrain query-wiki did not respond. No results were fabricated.
